title: SentGraph: Hierarchical Sentence Graph for Multi-hop Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
authors: Junli Liang; Pengfei Zhou; Wangqiu Zhou; Wenjie Qing; Qi Zhao; Ziwen Wang; Qi Song; Xiangyang Li
why_relevant: Proposes a sentence-level graph RAG method for multi-hop QA, aiming to reduce irrelevant context, but does not directly study robustness, noise, conflict, or calibration.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on retrieval granularity/structure for multi-hop QA, not on robustness under unreliable evidence.
